page_title: UDI 1-1 SAL | Udinese v Salernitana 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just over the bar.
90+4' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+4' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) outjumps his marker inside the box and heads the resulting corner way wide of the right post.
90+3' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) will deliver the corner kick.

90+3' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Toma Basic (Salernitana) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' The resulting corner from Toma Basic (Salernitana) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
90' Toma Basic (Salernitana) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
89' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. The ball is out of play and Salernitana manage to earn a corner.
87' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
86' Fabio Liverani has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Junior Sambia (Salernitana) replacing Alessandro Zanoli.
86' Substitution. Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) on for Giulio Maggiore.
85' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) swings in a cross from the corner, but Guillermo Ochoa reads it well and gathers the ball.

85' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The ball goes behind for a corner. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
85' There's an opportunity for Sandi Lovric (Udinese) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
81' Domagoj Bradaric floats over the corner and Marco Pellegrino (Salernitana) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
81' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

81' Toma Basic (Salernitana) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Salernitana.
80' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
79' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
75' Here is a change. Hassane Kamara is going off and Gabriele Cioffi gives the last tactical orders to Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
75' Walace (Udinese) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee. Walace (Udinese) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
74' Loum Tchaouna plays a short pass through to Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar.
73' Substitution. Iron Gomis (Salernitana) replaces Lassana Coulibaly.
72' Fabio Liverani is forced to make a change. Konstantinos Manolas is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Triantafyllos Pasalidis (Salernitana).

72' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Walace (Udinese) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies well wide of the left post towards the corner flag. Very poor shot.
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Shon Weissman as he is replaced by Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana).
70' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the right-hand post!
69' Toma Basic (Salernitana) runs onto a pass and thumps the ball goalward from distance, but the keeper doesn't have to move as it goes well wide of the right post.
67' Gabriele Cioffi makes a tactical change due to a red card. Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) comes on in place of Martin Payero.
64' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) is given a yellow card by Gianluca Manganiello and because it's his second one today, the game is over for him.
62' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Florian Thauvin, but the ball goes just over the bar.
60' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
57' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
56' One of the players from Udinese times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
56' A quickly taken corner by Udinese.
56' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Udinese.
52' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) takes the free kick from the edge of the box. His decent attempt goes narrowly wide of the left post.
51' A free kick on the edge of the box for Udinese. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
50' Marco Pellegrino (Salernitana) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
49' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
47' Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
46' Good movement by Hassane Kamara (Udinese), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Toma Basic (Salernitana) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
45+3' 1 - 1 GOOOOOAL! Hassane Kamara (Udinese) finds space in the box from the lofted pass and lands the perfect scissor-kick goal. G.O.A.T? Probably not, but it’s 1:1.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the top left corner. Guillermo Ochoa displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
42' Martin Payero (Udinese) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Guillermo Ochoa.
41' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
39' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
39' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
38' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Martin Payero (Udinese).
33' Shon Weissman (Salernitana) wastes a huge opportunity from inside the penalty area after unleashing a powerful first-time volley towards goal that goes well wide of the left post.
29' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
27' Close! Sandi Lovric (Udinese) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
26' Shon Weissman (Salernitana) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Gianluca Manganiello stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
24' 4:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:1.
18' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range low towards the middle of the net, but Guillermo Ochoa was alert and made an amazing save!
17' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends a long ball forward to Hassane Kamara, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
16' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card. Festy Ebosele (Udinese) will miss the next game.
13' Udinese have a goal ruled out for offside!
10' 0 - 1 Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
9' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
8' Shon Weissman picks out Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana), who drives a shot just over the crossbar from the edge of the box.
7' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
6' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) trips an opposition player and Gianluca Manganiello signals a foul.
5' Martin Payero (Udinese) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
5' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
2' Salernitana failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Salernitana will have the kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello will officiate today.
